\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[scale only axis,width=60mm,height=36mm,
    xmin=0,xmax=10,ymin=0,ymax=6,enlargelimits=false,
    axis lines=box,xtick=\empty,ytick=\empty]
    \addplot[only marks,blue,mark=*,error bars/.cd,
        x dir=both,x explicit,y dir=both,y explicit]
        coordinates {(2,2) += (.8,1.2) -= (.5,.6)};
    \addplot[only marks,red,mark=*,error bars/.cd,
        x dir=minus,x fixed=1.5,y dir=plus,y fixed relative=.25,
        error bar style={line width=.8pt},
        error mark options={rotate=90,mark size=3pt}]
        coordinates {(6,4)};
    \addplot[only marks,green!50!black,mark=*,error bars/.cd,
        x dir=none,y dir=minus,y fixed=.8,error mark=none]
        coordinates {(8,2.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
